description.narrative: Contribution to UNEP for 2022, core and earmarked

The Danish core contribution to UNEP 2022-2025 is based on an organisation strategy, which sets out four overall key priority areas 1. Climate Action: Green and Just Transition, where Denmark will focus on UNEP’s efforts on water resource management and fresh water ecosystem health; energy transition, phasing out fossil fuels and access to energy; and sustainable food systems. 2. Nature Action: Biodiversity and Nature-based Solutions, where Denmark will focus on UNEP’s efforts to lead the UN Decade on ecosystem restoration; and UNEP’s role in the development and implementation of the new post-2020 Global Biodiversity Framework. 3. Chemicals and Pollution Action: Sustainable Consumption and Production, where Denmark will focus on UNEP's work with SDG 12 including ways to promote resource efficiency and decoupling of economic growth from environmental degradation; pollution, specifically the sound management of chemicals and waste; governance of plastic pollution and marine litter; and UNEP’s cooperation with WHO, FAO and OIE on the One Health approach. 4. Governance: A More Effective and Efficient UNEP, where Denmark will focus on UNEP’s efforts to report and showcase the concrete results and impact; UNEP’s normative and scientific role; the importance of ensuring increased core funding; and UNEP’s efforts to increase responsiveness to gender equality and human rights.
The organisation strategy is based on UNEP's Medium Term Strategy: https://www.unep.org/resources/policy-and-strategy/people-and-planet-unep-strategy-2022-2025
